title: it’s pride month go see cats at @PAC NYC 😻 #catsthejellicleball #cats...
transcript: Join me at the theater tonight I'm seeing Cats: The Jellicle Ball at the Perelman Arts Center. If you told me last year that one of my most anticipated shows in 2024 was going to be CATS! I would not have believed you. Now don't get me wrong I am a Cats fan. I love the music. I think the show is absurd and fun and people that don't like it don't get it. But I love a reimagining of a show. So when I heard that Ballroom Cats was coming I was fascinated by how it would work and to me Cats: the Jellicle Ball is everything a revival should do this show is completely reimagined. Now I do think some familiarity with ballroom culture would be helpful go watch the documentary Paris is burning its really excellent. But even without that I think it’s impossible not to appreciate what you are experiencing. which is a Cats that is unapologetically Black and Latino and queer any yet still very much feels like Cats it really is the perfect combination of Broadway and ballroom the choreography and the costumes and the characters are so fun shout out to my boy Andre De Shields his introduction in this is how he should be introduced literally everywhere this is not a sit still watch and be quiet kind of show. they want you to be engaged bring those fans, cheer, clap and be loud for your favorite I think the more you bring to the show the more the show will bring to you I don't think I stopped smiling one time the entire night if you love Cats this is a revival that you cannot miss and if you don't like Cats I actually this is more important that you see it. The truly is how we should be reviving classic work and I cannot wait to return to the Jellicle Ball
reasoning: The reviewer expresses overwhelming enthusiasm throughout, calling it 'everything a revival should do' and stating they 'didn't stop smiling one time.' They give clear recommendations for both Cats fans ('cannot miss') and non-fans ('more important that you see it').
keyQuote: this is everything a revival should do this show is completely reimagined... I don't think I stopped smiling one time the entire night
